objective: Demod microservice: envelope-detector AM demod consuming the channelizer's narrowband VITA49 contract (915 MHz + 200 kHz offset, 50 kS/s, integer decimation). Deliver a Demod trait whose first implementation is AM/DSB envelope detection (carrier present) with the NBFM seam left as a second impl, plus its own child directory, Dockerfile, Deployment/Service/ConfigMap and kaniko Job. Output: WAV + sidecar JSON with discontinuity markers recorded from seq gaps, and a /metrics endpoint (RSSI, SNR, frequency offset, drops, gaps). Artifacts land on PVC/emptyDir until RustFS exists. Decision recorded so it is not re-litigated: AM/DSB envelope detection is the default; true USB/SSB suppressed-carrier needs a BFO + product detector and is a separate option. If a 48 kHz WAV is required, add a 50 kS/s -> 48 kS/s resample here
verificationContract: cargo test --workspace green with an AM tone-recovery test within +-5 Hz, the demod runs as its own pod in k8s, and a WAV artifact recovered from the cluster contains the expected 1 kHz tone.
